100-thieves.zh: 100 Thieves 开局 20 秒的 CT 默认站位为 A2 M1 B2，占 30% 的枪局，胜率 17%。
100-thieves.en: 100 Thieves' default CT setup at 20 s is A2 M1 B2, used in 30% of gun rounds with a 17% win rate.

aurora.zh: Aurora 最常用的爆弹是 B 点警家烟加 B连接烟，12 次赢 9 次。CT 方开局 20 秒的默认站位为 A1 M2 B2，占 27% 的枪局，胜率 78%。
aurora.en: Aurora's go-to execute is B with CT smoke and Palace smoke, used 12 times with 9 wins. Their default CT setup at 20 s is A1 M2 B2, used in 27% of gun rounds with a 78% win rate.

betboom.zh: 防守端偏爱堆点，26% 的枪局选择堆点，远高于其他队伍的 9%（19 个枪局）。
betboom.en: On CT they stack a site in 26% of gun rounds versus 9% for other teams (19 gun rounds).

eyeballers.zh: EYEBALLERS 开局 20 秒的 CT 默认站位为 A2 M1 B2，占 38% 的枪局，胜率 50%。
eyeballers.en: EYEBALLERS' default CT setup at 20 s is A2 M1 B2, used in 38% of gun rounds with a 50% win rate.

falcons.zh: Falcons 最常用的爆弹是 B 点警家烟加 B连接烟，27 次赢 18 次。最常摸边的人是 NiKo，20 次进攻时他在另一侧或远离进攻点。
falcons.en: Falcons' go-to execute is B with CT smoke and Palace smoke, used 27 times with 18 wins. Their usual lurker is NiKo, who was on the other side or far from the hit in 20 attacks.

flyquest.zh: jks 是最常摸边的人，4 次进攻时身处另一侧或远离进攻点。
flyquest.en: jks is the usual lurker (4 hits with him on the other side or far away).

furia.zh: FURIA 最常用的爆弹是 B 点警家烟加 B连接烟，9 次赢 7 次。最常摸边的人是 KSCERATO，7 次进攻时他在另一侧或远离进攻点。
furia.en: FURIA's go-to execute is B with CT smoke and Palace smoke, used 9 times with 7 wins. Their usual lurker is KSCERATO, who was on the other side or far from the hit in 7 attacks.

fut-esports.zh: FUT Esports 最常用的爆弹是 A 点天堂烟、A连接烟、A包点火（天堂侧）、A连接火（包点出口）加喷泉火，5 次赢 2 次。最常摸边的人是 dziugss，5 次进攻时他在另一侧或远离进攻点。
fut-esports.en: FUT Esports' go-to execute is A with Heaven smoke, A connector smoke, A site molotov (Heaven side), A connector molotov (site exit) and Fountain molotov, used 5 times with 2 wins. Their usual lurker is dziugss, who was on the other side or far from the hit in 5 attacks.

g2.zh: G2 最常用的爆弹是 A 点天堂烟、A连接烟、A包点火（天堂侧）、A连接火（包点出口）加喷泉火，8 次赢 5 次。CT 方开局 20 秒的默认站位为 A1 M2 B2，占 35% 的枪局，胜率 59%。
g2.en: G2's go-to execute is A with Heaven smoke, A connector smoke, A site molotov (Heaven side), A connector molotov (site exit) and Fountain molotov, used 8 times with 5 wins. Their default CT setup at 20 s is A1 M2 B2, used in 35% of gun rounds with a 59% win rate.

mibr.en: MIBR's default CT setup is A2 M1 B2 at 20 s, used in 52% of gun rounds and won 91% of them.

natus-vincere.zh: Natus Vincere 最常用的爆弹是 B 点 B连接烟加 B后点火，9 次赢 6 次。CT 方开局 20 秒的默认站位为 A1 M2 B2，占 25% 的枪局，胜率 37%。
natus-vincere.en: Natus Vincere's go-to execute is B with Palace smoke and Back site molotov (B), used 9 times with 6 wins. Their default CT setup at 20 s is A1 M2 B2, used in 25% of gun rounds with a 37% win rate.

spirit.en: Spirit's usual lurker is zont1x, who was on the other side or far from the hit in 20 attacks. Their default CT setup at 20 s is A2 M1 B2, used in 30% of gun rounds with a 57% win rate.
